gaps.lead: He started playing golf at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ golf at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby/sport): took up golf.

gaps.lead: When I was a boy, we walked everywhere.
gaps.sentence: When I was a boy, we ___ everywhere.
gaps.explanation: used to + infinitive expresses a past habit.

gaps.lead: The soup needed a bit of salt.
gaps.explanation: needed a bit of salt = didn't have enough (salt).

gaps.lead: It's a pity you didn't tell me earlier.
gaps.explanation: should/ought to have + participle expresses past regret/advice.

gaps.lead: Only after reading the letter twice did it make sense.
gaps.sentence: The letter ___ sense until he had read it twice.
gaps.explanation: It didn't make sense until… = it made sense only after…

gaps.lead: Don't worry — the shops will still be open when you arrive.
gaps.explanation: Future simple with still: will still be open.
